tnInbox.title: Home
tnInbox.lede: Home is the one screen an operator keeps open. The top half is everything that needs a person: a decision, a reply, a retry. The bottom half is the work already in flight.
tnInbox.empty: Nothing needs you. Start work in the composer below.

reply.label: reply {{id}}
reply.placeholder: Reply to the worker — answer the question above…
reply.status: Enter sends the reply · Shift+Enter (or Ctrl+J) newline · the prompt is a trap in front of the composer
reply.sent: sent the reply · Enter sends · Shift+Enter newline
reply.empty: nothing to reply · Enter sends · Shift+Enter newline
reply.failed: Could not send the reply. Retry in a moment.
reply.dismiss: Esc dismisses the prompt and moves to the composer

composer.placeholder: Ask the Router, or press / at column 0…
composer.status: Enter sends · Shift+Enter (or Ctrl+J) newline · / at column 0 opens the palette prefilled with /
composer.hint: Focus order when the palette is closed: the main list, then the composer. j and k on the focused transcript scroll one row; PageUp and PageDown scroll ten.
composer.title: Short title (optional)
composer.prompt: Describe the task. You will track and close it here.
composer.needWorkspace: Choose a workspace for this task.

tnInbox.loadError: Could not read Tickets. Check the connection and retry.

clarify.label: confirm {{id}}
clarify.placeholder: The request the worker will start from — edit anything that misses what you meant…
clarify.status: Enter confirms this request and starts the Ticket · Shift+Enter (or Ctrl+J) newline
clarify.empty: nothing to confirm · Enter confirms · Shift+Enter newline
clarify.failed: Could not confirm. Retry in a moment.
clarify.unavailable: No drafted request to confirm here. Open the Ticket to review it.
